about: Krusty Krab vs. Chum Bucket puts the two rival Bikini Bottom restaurants from SpongeBob SquarePants side by side with a big red "VS" between them. On the left is the Krusty Krab, a busy, beloved burger joint built from a lobster trap; on the right is Plankton's Chum Bucket, a lonely metal pail that nobody ever eats at. Captions label the left side with the popular, successful thing and the right side with its sad, struggling competitor, so the meme works as a quick verdict on who is winning a rivalry.
origin: Both restaurants come from SpongeBob SquarePants, where Plankton spends episode after episode trying and failing to steal the Krabby Patty formula so his Chum Bucket can finally get customers.
usage:
Put the winner in the left box over the Krusty Krab and the loser in the right box over the Chum Bucket. Keep each label short, ideally a brand, product or team name, so the comparison reads instantly.

It lands when the rivalry is real and the gap is obvious: the original vs. the knockoff, the market leader vs. the copycat, the thing you have vs. the version your parents bought. Swapping the order on purpose, putting a beloved underdog on the Chum Bucket, also works as a hot take.
